Job Description: GenAI/Python Developer – AI/ML 

 
 Role Overview

 8+ years overall experience and at least one year in GenAI

 Design, develop, and deploy Generative AI applications using LLMs (OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Claude, Llama) and frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or Semantic Kernel.

 Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines integrating vector databases (Pinecone, pgvector) with data sources.

 Engineer agent skills, implement function/tool calling, and develop AI agents for automation and multi-step reasoning tasks.



 Skills: 

 Python / Node.js / SQL

 OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, LangChain, LlamaIndex, vector databases

 AWS Bedrock, Azure, GCP, Google Vertex

 MCP, MLFlow, LangSmith

 TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn

 Hugging Face Transformers

 Apache Spark, Airflow, Kafka

  

 Compensation, Benefits and Duration 

 Minimum Compensation: 155,000 USD 

 Maximum Compensation: 217,000 USD

 Compensation is based on actual experience and qualifications of the candidate. The above is a reasonable and a good faith estimate for the role.

 Medical, vision, and dental benefits, 401k retirement plan, variable pay/incentives, paid time off, and paid holidays are available for full-time employees.

 This position is not available for independent contractors

 No applications will be considered if received more than 120 days after the date of this post.
